parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "claude-fable-5", max_tokens: 1500, system: "You are the assistant for Nexum, a web design agency in New Jersey. A potential client just submitted the contact form. Write a warm, concise, professional reply in English (3-4 sentences) that acknowledges their message, references what they asked about, and proposes a short intro call as the next step. Sign off as 'The Nexum Team'. Return only the email body text.", messages: [{ role: "user", content: "New Nexum contact form submission. Name: " + ($json.body.name || "-") + ". Firm: " + ($json.body.firm || "-") + ". Email: " + ($json.body.email || "-") + ". Intent: " + ($json.body.intent || "-") + ". Their message: " + ($json.body.message || "-") }] }) }}

parameters.subject: =New Nexum lead — {{ $('Webhook (form submission)').item.json.body.name || 'unknown' }}

nodes.name: Email the lead to you
nodes.notes: Connect your Gmail credential here (or replace with the SMTP 'Send Email' node). Change 'you@nexum.com' to your real inbox.

meta.description: Receives a Nexum contact-form POST, asks Claude (Anthropic API) to draft a reply, emails you the lead + draft, and returns {success:true} to the website.
